evidence: Refactors block index parameter types and CChain internal storage (to std::reference_wrapper) in src/chain.h and src/chain.cpp.
rationale: This is an internal janitorial refactor to pass CBlockIndex by reference instead of pointer for compile-time non-null enforcement. The author characterizes it as a 'janitorial refactor' providing a 'slight improvement in code quality, maintainability and robustness' with no changes to validation behavior or performance.
